Indian Airforce Group Y Medical Assistant Airmen 02/2027 Online Form - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Air Force (Bhartiya Vayu Sena) has release the notification for the post of Group ‘Y’ Medical Assistant Airmen trade (Intake 01/2027) on its official website. The online application process for Indian Airforce Group Y Medical Assistant Airmen 02/2027 Recruitment will start from 06 July 2026, and candidates can apply till 26 July 2026. Any candidate who is interested to fill this form, they should check eligibility, age limit & must read the Full Notification Before applying for the Indian Airforce Group Y Medical Assistant Airmen 02/2027 Recruitment. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 July 2026
  • Last Date : 26 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 22-23 September 2026
  • Exam City Intimation: September 2026
  • Admit Card: 24-48 Hours Before the Exam Date

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 550/- (+18% GST Extra)
  • SC, ST : Rs. 550/- (+18% GST Extra)
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
